text: APPROVE. Replacing the two nested try/catch blocks (two catches each at nesting 1) with two `if (… is null)` checks should bring the complexity to about 13, and `TryList` still materializes the enumeration inside the try with the same exceptions caught, so the `continue` and skip behaviour is unchanged. I could not build it here, and I did not rule out a Sonar-style "return empty collection instead of null" rule that could fail a warnings-as-errors build.
